behavior_caveats: The source computes CX=(length+1)>>1 in 16-bit arithmetic, then enters the LOOP body once before LOOP decrements CX. A zero length (and 0xffff after INC wrap) therefore cycles through 65536 inner iterations; this is the static machine behavior, not an assertion about intended input.
The outer block loop is do-while-shaped: it decrements count after processing, so an initial count of zero wraps and runs 65536 passes. This static behavior does not establish intended inputs.
STOSB follows DF and the routine contains no CLD. Byte equality does not prove the caller enters with DF=0; no original runtime trace was used.
